scope: Six predeclared environment-only cases around frozen successful v5 controller. One shared three-robot/six-job episode per case, correlated jobs; no tuning after outcomes. Host nominal is a host/driver control, not an independent randomized replication. Existing certified model mission reused without fresh inference.
runtime_scope: Run commands use the same host interpreter and frozen v5 source; v5 does not directly record per-run GL/MuJoCo versions. Resource receipts remain separate.

cases.applies_to: all three robots, both physical jobs

model_mission.scope: Recorded model output, complete-language certificate and executed tree agree; fresh sensor grounding and physical outcomes are separate checks.

validation.scope: Current continuous one-second placement from retained sampled geometry/contact/speed/clearance/grip; controller-only dependency ordering and exact workcell pairs. Dynamics are not reconstructed. Legacy probes without initial-state hashes report a computed hash only, not independently anchored initial-state verification.

a.pose_error_scope: Scoring-only comparison to retained truth; never supplied to controller. Fresh≤110ms observations, pickup active before close only; destination all active phases.
